jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Fin

Fin is a next-generation payments platform built for high-value, global, and instant transactions. We are a Series A-stage company backed by Sequoia, Circle, and other notable investors. Powered by stablecoins, Fin enables users and businesses to move millions of dollars in seconds - whether to other Fin users, directly into bank accounts, or across crypto rails. By combining the speed of crypto with the reliability and trust of traditional finance, Fin reimagines how money moves worldwide. If banks and payment products were reinvented today, they would look like Fin.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Manager to join our growing product team. You will be responsible for guiding products from early ideation through implementation and continuous improvement. This encompasses user research, product definition, operational management, pricing strategy, go-to-market planning, and post-launch iteration.

Stablecoins are transforming the payments landscape, enabling money to move faster, cheaper, and across borders with ease. In this role, you’ll play a critical part in shaping the future of global money movement.

Responsibilities

  • Lead products end-to-end, from user research and concept exploration to development, launch, and ongoing iteration

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, operations, compliance, growth) to define product requirements and ensure seamless execution.

  • Drive product shaping, including problem definition, feature scoping, roadmap prioritization, and alignment around key goals

  • Manage day-to-day operational details, including edge-case handling, internal process setup, tooling needs, and ensuring product readiness for launch

  • Track product performance through metrics and qualitative feedback, identifying opportunities for improvement and steering rapid iteration cycles

  • Work with external partners (ramp providers, DeFi solutions, fintech vendors, and more) to deliver integrated, seamless product experiences

Qualifications

  • Proven experience in product management and/or business development, with a track record of taking products from 0→1 or scaling them from early adoption to broader market fit.

  • Experience collaborating with internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, designers, operators, sales, and strategic partners.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting product strategy and insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • A data-driven mindset with the ability to leverage analytics to inform decisions, diagnose problems, and drive improvements.

  • A strong bias toward action, you’re comfortable moving fast, navigating ambiguity, and getting hands-on to solve problems.

Bonus Points

  • Background in fintech or traditional financial services, with familiarity in areas like payment flows, FX, treasury operations, compliance, etc.

  • An understanding of (or interest in) Web3 ecosystems, including DeFi protocols, custody models, smart contracts, or crypto liquidity.

  • Data analytics experience (SQL, Python)

  • Prior experience at an early-stage startup, showing comfort with ambiguity, rapid iteration, and building processes from scratch

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As a Senior Product Manager, you own the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for a key product area within Rithum's commerce platform. You operate largely independently, tackle open-ended and ambiguous problems, and bring cross-functional teams together around a shared vision. You are expected to have deep expertise in your domain and leverage AI-powered capabilities to rapidly shape the next generation of commerce for the world's largest retailers and brands.

Responsibilities

  • Be the owner of your product and drive the long-term vision for the world’s leading eCommerce platform, leveraging AI-first approaches to accelerate discovery, decision-making, and delivery.
  • Synthesize qualitative inputs—including client interviews, support tickets, and survey feedback—using AI tools to identify themes, opportunity areas, and prioritization inputs that inform product strategy.
  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and cross-functional teams to drive efficient business processes, improve team operations, and align client needs with internal objectives.
  • Own and drive roadmap prioritization for your product area, making independent decisions on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs while incorporating AI-assisted insights and data exploration.
  • Leverage AI tools to prototype and validate product concepts and workflows (e.g., user flows, wireframe descriptions, low-fidelity mocks) to de-risk ideas prior to engineering investment.
  • Lead end-to-end product development & execution from concept to launch (e.g., PRDs, prioritization, client discussions, testing & QA, change management, client adoption/engagement, etc.), holding yourself and your cross-functional team accountable for high-quality, timely delivery.
  • Use AI to accelerate product documentation workflows (PRDs, one-pagers, release notes) while exercising strong editorial judgment and maintaining product quality and clarity.
  • Track development progress, report on status to stakeholders, and assist in managing product release cycles. Support product testing and validation to ensure high-quality releases and a seamless user experience.
  • Be the voice and champion of our clients; triage incoming requests with urgency and follow-through and build relationships grounded in trust.
  • Lead and influence stakeholders across functional teams of designers and engineers to ensure successful delivery at a fast velocity; ensuring high product validation and QA standards are met.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders at all levels of the organization to gain buy-in and alignment on product strategies, goals and initiatives, balancing urgency and resource availability.
  • Leverage AI-assisted data exploration and analysis (e.g., natural language querying, chart interpretation, anomaly identification) to support faster, evidence-based product decisions.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of proven product management experience within the SAAS industry with a complex enterprise level product, preferably in eCommerce or marketplace platforms
  • Experience as a Product Manager working on AI‑powered products, AI workflows, or data & insights platforms
  • Strong experience with the full product development lifecycle, including setting goals for your products, measuring the results, and quantifying the impact of features on the business
  • Experience driving strategy and execution for complex, integrated software ecosystems, particularly with unifying multiple platforms
  • Proven experience in supporting team-based projects, with a focus on ensuring alignment with project goals and contributing to technical teams.
  • Experience using AI tools to synthesize qualitative research (e.g., client interviews, support tickets, survey feedback) into structured themes, opportunity areas, and/or prioritization inputs.
  • Experience prototyping product concepts or workflows using AI tools (e.g., generating wireframe descriptions, user flows, or low-fidelity mockups via AI) to validate ideas before engineering investment.
  • Proven use of AI to accelerate documentation workflows (PRDs, release notes, one pagers, etc.) while maintaining high quality and appropriate editorial judgment.
  • Comfort using AI-assisted tools for data exploration and analysis (e.g., natural language querying of datasets, AI-generated chart interpretation, or anomaly identification) to support faster, evidence-based decisions.
  • Strong ability to work with vendors and internal teams, ensuring effective communication with stakeholders for successful project delivery.
  • Comfortable presenting product strategy and impact to stakeholders across all levels of the organization
  • Analytically minded with proficiency in data-driven decision making and experience with product analytics tools
  • Experience collaborating with large clients – our clients are some of the biggest in commerce
  • Positive & growth-oriented mindset with a strong bias to action
  • Strong and concise written & verbal communication skills with the ability impactfully tailor your communication to any audience
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments and manage multiple projects simultaneously

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelors or Advanced degree
  • 5+ years of product management experience
  • PM experience at a top tech company or fast-growing startup preferably in eCommerce
  • Intrapreneurial/founder mindset
  • Experience working on a global product management team

Travel Required

Up to 10%

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

At Rithum you will:

  • Partner with the leading brands and retailers.
  • Connect with passionate professionals who will help support your goals.
  • Participate in an inclusive, welcoming work atmosphere.
  • Achieve work-life balance through remote-first working conditions, generous time off, and wellness days.
  • Receive industry-competitive compensation and total rewards benefits.

We believe in transparency and fairness in our compensation practices.

For this position, the expected base pay range is: $135,000-$200,000 per year.

This range represents the base pay for the role across all U.S. locations and is determined based on market data, internal equity, and experience. Final compensation may vary depending on geographic location, skills, and relevant experience.In addition to base pay, we offer a discretionary bonus for non-sales roles, a comprehensive benefits package, and, where applicable, sales incentives.

For this position, the expected discretionary bonus is 10% of the annual base salary.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision benefits: Affordable health care plans and company HSA contributions, starting on Day 1
  • A 6% 401(k) match
  • Competitive time off package with 20 days of Paid Time Off, 9 Company-Paid holidays, 2 paid floating holidays, 7 paid sick days, 2 Wellness days, and 1 Paid Volunteer Day; at 3 years of service PTO increases to 22 days, and at 5 years it increases to 25 days
  • 12 weeks primary caregiver leave & 4 weeks secondary caregiver leave
  • Accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity insurance
  • Pet insurance
  • Legal assistance and identity theft insurance plans
  • Life insurance 2x salary
  • Access to the Calm app and the Employee Assistance Program
  • $65/month Remote work stipend for internet
  • Culture and team-building activities
  • Tuition assistance
  • Career development opportunities
  • Charitable contribution match up to $250 per year

Rithum is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other protected characteristic. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations in accordance with the law for qualified applicants. If you require assistance during the interview process due to a medical condition or need support accessing our website or completing the application process, please reach out to us by completing the Accommodations Request Form. Your comfort and accessibility are important to us, and we're here to ensure a seamless experience as you explore opportunities with our team.

jobs.title: Supply Lead
jobs.jd_full:
Claru (a Reka business line) · San Francisco or remote · Full-time

Text has run out. The physical world — where skill lives — has never been recorded in a form a model can learn from. Claru is building that layer.

We sell data to frontier labs and robotics companies: zero to seven figures of ARR in under six months, with a team of five. It is a two-sided marketplace: labs arrive with a research problem and a budget, not a specification; contributors and partner businesses capture the work they already do, paid per approved unit. This job is the supply side.

We are hiring a Supply Lead and are looking for operators who are AI-native: more time with agents than with people, automation before hiring, systems that scale rather than teams that grow. That is how a team this small outruns much bigger companies. You need to be someone who can be dropped into an unfamiliar market and come back with capacity that is real.

What you'll do

  • Build a portfolio of partner businesses — whose staff capture the work they already do on shift — across the environments buyers want: event venues, retail back-of-house, construction, agriculture, hotels, warehousing. Each is won in a real conversation

  • Grow the contributor base alongside it and open new geographies, keeping supply owned and multi-channel so no single partner or geography is a dependency.

  • Own the geo rate card — what an approved unit costs by market and project type — so engagements are priced and staffed against something defensible

  • Own capacity forecasting — whether we can deliver a given volume in a given environment in a given number of weeks — which a Program Lead commits against.

  • Own contributor experience and retention: onboarding, payments landing on time, support, and why people stop.

  • Partner with the platform team on the tooling that makes supply self-serve

A typical day

There is no standard one, but a real day might run like this: you start on the partner businesses already live — chasing the ones gone quiet, calling the two that signed last month and have not filmed. Contributor payments in one market did not land, so you find where it stopped and clear it. A Program Lead needs to know whether we can cover four weeks of warehouse capture in a new country, and you give them a number you would stand behind. Then a first conversation with a food manufacturer about putting their team on shift and collecting data.

What we're looking for

  • Early-stage marketplace operating experience — required. You have got one side of a flywheel turning from a standing start, in a new territory or a new vertical — recruitment, pricing, retention and economics. Every new market here is that problem again

  • AI-native — required. You spend more time with agents than with people, you automate a process before you staff it, and your answer to more volume is a better system rather than more headcount

  • You have operated, not only advised. Former founders, high growth early stage startup hires, consulting, or business operations background is a strong plus and exactly the rigour we want

  • You close business yourself: partner businesses are won in conversation

  • Numerate — you build the model, find where the cost per unit breaks, and argue for the change

  • Credible with a company owner and with a shift supervisor alike

  • Bonus: exposure to AI labs or training data pipelines

Reka's Mission

Claru is a part of Reka (VC backed by NVIDIA). Reka's mission is to build useful multimodal artificial intelligence and use it to empower organisations and businesses. We are a globally distributed foundation model startup, headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, California. Embracing a remote-first approach, our team brings together top talent from around the world. Our founding team, along with many of our team members, has contributed to many of the breakthroughs in AI over the past decade.

Reka was founded by researchers from Google DeepMind and FAIR, and ships Reka Vision, launched in July 2026, and Reka Edge, a 7B vision-language model. Reka's leadership includes the team behind Moonvalley's Marey, the first video model trained entirely on licensed data. Claru is Reka's data business, supplying the training data behind physical AI, embodied AI and world models.

Why Reka?

  • An Elite Team: Collaborate with top-tier engineers, researchers, operators from renowned organizations like Google DeepMind and Facebook AI Research (FAIR) and successful startups, driving innovation in cutting-edge AI technology.

  • Massive Market Opportunity: Be part of a rapidly growing industry poised to transform multiple sectors globally, offering the chance to make a significant impact.

  • Mission-Driven Environment: Work alongside a collaborative, mission-focused team dedicated to advancing AI for meaningful applications.

  • Inclusive and Open Culture: Thrive in an open and inclusive work environment that values diverse perspectives and fosters creativity.

  • Generous Benefits: Enjoy 5 weeks of paid leave to recharge, comprehensive healthcare benefits including vision and dental, and additional perks that support your well-being.

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager Smart Metering & Steering (m/f/d)
jobs.jd_full:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

As the energy transition accelerates, flexibilities in the low-voltage grid become increasingly important - and smart metering and steering of distributed energy resources sit at the heart of this shift. You take a central role in our end-to-end steering proposition, turning regulatory complexity into scalable, compliant, and customer-friendly products at the intersection of regulation, product, hardware, and field operations.

  • Be the Expert on Smart Metering & Steering Regulation: Act as the first point of contact - internally and externally - for regulatory developments such as §14a EnWG, §9 EEG, §21 EnWG, and §118 Abs. 6 EnWG. Interpret legal frameworks, VDE FNN requirements, BNetzA rulings, and BDEW Guidelines, and help shape the rules of tomorrow through active industry engagement.
  • Translate Regulation into Product Requirements: Define and prioritize development requirements for our engineering teams to ensure Heartbeat AI and connected hardware (e.g. §14a Steuerbox + Smart Meter) meets all compliance and performance standards.
  • Drive Hardware Strategy and Rollout: Coordinate testing and lab capacities, prepare key hardware decisions, and operationalize the rollout of intelligent metering systems and Steuerboxen across our customer segment.
  • Manage Service Providers and Market Partners: Own relationships with external service providers as well as DSOs and metering point operators, ensuring smooth collaboration and reliable market communication processes.
  • Lead Cross-Functional Projects & Monitor Performance: Take overarching project responsibility for steering initiatives, define KPIs, monitor target achievement, and derive optimization measures from data and field feedback.

Dein Profil

General:

  • 3+ years of experience in the energy sector with a clear focus on metering and steering
  • Strong project management skills, leading cross-functional initiatives across internal teams, network and metering point operators, and external service providers
  • Analytical, structured thinker who can define KPIs and use data to drive decisions
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable navigating ambiguity and regulatory change
  • Excellent written and spoken German and English - German is essential given the heavy regulatory and partner interaction

Domain & Regulatory Expertise:

  • Solid working knowledge of §14a EnWG and the grid-oriented control of consumption and generation assets, as well as the broader regulatory framework (MsbG, §9 EEG, §21 EnWG, §118 Abs. 6 EnWG)
  • Familiarity with relevant technical standards and guidelines, as well as Marktkommunikationsprozesse and smart metering infrastructure
  • Experience coordinating hardware testing, lab setups, or certification processes (e.g. for §14a Steuerboxen) is a strong plus

Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe's most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

jobs.title: Project Manager - Retail Construction (12-18 Month Contract)
jobs.jd_full:
Great Place to Work Certified™
Best Workplaces™ in British Columbia 2025
Best Workplaces™ in Retail & Hospitality 2025  

Project Manager (12-18 Month Contract)

Reports to: Senior Project Manager

Location: Toronto, ON

Employment Type: Full-time, 12-18 month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of extension

At COBS Bread, we are growing and improving our bakery network and looking for an organized, collaborative Project Manager to join our Growth team on a fixed-term basis. You will lead new bakery build-outs, renovations and related projects, ensuring work is delivered on time, within budget and to COBS Bread standards.

Reporting to the Senior Project Manager, you will coordinate franchisees, Operations, Property, Supply Chain, contractors and external authorities throughout the project lifecycle. This role offers the opportunity to manage multiple retail construction projects, influence practical bakery design and support an exceptional franchisee experience.

What you will be responsible for:

Project Planning and Delivery

  • Manage new bakery build-outs, renovations and related projects from initial planning through completion and handover.
  • Develop project schedules, communicate key milestones and lead project kick-off meetings with franchisees and relevant stakeholders.
  • Work with Property and Real Estate teams to verify project information, landlord requirements and timelines.
  • Coordinate with external authorities, landlords and contractors to meet applicable regulations and ensure agreed landlord works are completed before site handover.

Budgets, Documentation and Compliance

  • Prepare preliminary cost estimates, detailed scopes of work and project budgets for franchisee and internal approvals.
  • Coordinate preliminary and final drawings, tender documents, contracts, purchase orders and required sign-offs.
  • Manage required permits, legal approvals, project authorization and final occupancy documentation.
  • Monitor schedule and costs throughout delivery and complete project financial reconciliation following completion.

Bakery Design and Continuous Improvement

  • Coordinate sketch plans, design briefs and technical documentation to support practical, efficient bakery layouts.
  • Ensure new bakery and renovation designs align with current COBS Bread fit-out manuals, brand standards and applicable requirements.
  • Provide constructive feedback on emerging design concepts, project processes and opportunities for cost savings.

Stakeholder Relationships and Reporting

  • Provide timely, accurate updates to franchisees, Operations and internal partners regarding project progress, risks and decisions.
  • Maintain current project records and reports on internal systems and prepare project summaries for stakeholders.
  • Resolve issues and concerns professionally, escalating where appropriate to keep projects on track.
  • Collaborate closely with the Project team and Supply Chain to share lessons learned and continuously improve project outcomes.

What you bring to the table:

  • 3-5 years of relevant project management experience, preferably including retail store build-outs, fit-outs or renovations.
  • Project management qualification or certification preferred.
  • Strong understanding of project management processes, construction documentation and stakeholder coordination in a retail environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, competing deadlines and complex stakeholder needs.
  • Strong problem-solving, negotiation, organizational and time-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, relationship-building, reporting and presentation skills.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to travel as required.

What’s in it for you: 

  • Flexible work arrangements with a combination of working in the Support Office and remotely
  • Competitive salary, bonus, and vacation plan
  • A great Extended Health & Dental Benefit, Group RRSP Matching, and Health and Lifestyle spending account
  • Paid sick and personal leave days
  • Paid day for community service and volunteer time
  • An open, ‘continuous-learning’ environment where professional development and career progression is encouraged
  • Work within a dynamic, driven, high-achieving, close-knit and fun-loving team
  • High level of autonomy and responsibility

_We thank all applicants for their interest in COBS Bread but would like to advise that only applicants shortlisted for interview will be contacted._ 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. 

About COBS Bread 

With over 190 locations, COBS Bread serves fresh and delightful baked goods to communities across Canada. Any unsold items are donated daily to various local charities and food banks. The company’s success can be attributed to the quality of our product, the development of our people and our warm and friendly customer service. 

COBS Bread is part of Bakers Delight – Established in 1980 operating as Bakers Delight in Australia and New Zealand, and since 2003 as COBS Bread in Canada and the USA. Together we have grown to more than 700 bakeries across Australia, New Zealand, Canada and the USA. The entire network employs over 15,000 people, serving more than 2.1 million customers each week.  

Our Values:

  • Bring Passion and Purpose – Being deeply connected to why we do what we do. Contribute to something meaningful to our team, customers, and community.
  • Be Open and Honest – Being clear, respectful, and transparent even when its uncomfortable. Creating a safe space for others to speak up, ask questions, and share ideas constructively.
  • Make it Better – Not settling for “good enough”: Always looking for ways to improve the way we work, the experience we offer, or how we grow as individuals and teams. Demonstrating a continuous learning mindset.
  • Take Ownership – taking responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks. Being clear on what we are accountable for, owning up to results (good or bad), and following through on commitments.

Accessibility

Accommodation is available upon request for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations needed to ensure you have access to a fair and equitable process. Any information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. 

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? 

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience? 

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About Fever for Business

Fever for Business (F4B) brings Fever’s experiences to companies, brands and institutions. We deliver private and exclusive versions of our shows (such as private Candlelight concerts), corporate events and gala dinners, branded activation, pop-ups, tourism and destination campaigns, and fully bespoke, multi-market productions designed around a client’s brief.

About the Role: 

We are looking for a F4B Project Manager who owns each client project on Fever’s behalf, from signed brief to delivery, and who has enough technical production knowledge to plan the event properly and challenge suppliers when needed.

You will be the client’s main point of contact at Fever. You will run client meetings, site visits and approvals; build the project P&L; coordinate Fever’s internal teams (Sales, production, PR, social media, finance, legal) and external suppliers; and make sure every event is delivered on time, on budget and to Fever’s standard.

When you join Fever, you will receive training and coaching to help you:

Client and project ownership

  • Act as Fever’s representative with the client from kick-off to wrap-up: lead calls, agendas, site visits, presentations and follow-up actions.
  • Turn client briefs into clear scopes, proposals, timelines and production plans; manage changes in scope, budget and timing.
  • Drive client approvals (content, PR, social media, run-of-show) and keep everyone aligned on deadlines.
  • Handle issues and escalations calmly, protect the client relationship and Fever’s reputation, and propose solutions rather than problems.
  • Work with F4B Sales on new opportunities: feasibility, venue options and production input before deals are signed.

Budget, venues and suppliers

  • Build and own the project P&L before contract, then track and reconcile actual costs.
  • Scout and shortlist venues, organise site visits and confirm a venue can deliver what the event needs.
  • Source, negotiate with and manage suppliers: AV and rigging, staging, staffing agencies, artists and performers, transport, storage and logistics.
  • Follow up on contracts and supplier payments with finance so nothing blocks delivery on site.

Technical production and execution

  • Understand and plan technical requirements: AV, lighting, sound, rigging, stage dimensions and layout, power and venue constraints.
  • Plan load-in and dismantle schedules, access and loading, accreditation, and onsite staffing levels.
  • Prepare or review run-of-show, production documents and risk assessments with producers and event managers.
  • Coordinate onsite delivery with producers, event managers and the client’s own production agency, onsite or remotely.

Scale the business

  • Work across markets and time zones on single and multi-market projects.
  • Capture learnings and build repeatable templates, processes and a strong supplier network as F4B grows.

About You: 

We are looking for someone who combines a strong commercial mindset, relationship-building abilities, and analytical thinking, with a proactive approach to developing partnerships and growing the business.

Must have

  • 3+ years in event or experiential project management or production, ideally agency-side (events, experiential or brand activation agency).
  • Proven experience as the main client contact, managing senior stakeholders with confidence.
  • Experience across varied formats: corporate events, gala dinners, branded activations, pop-ups and bespoke events.
  • Budget ownership: building P&Ls, negotiating with vendors and protecting margin.
  • Working technical knowledge of event production (AV, lighting, staging, rigging, load-in and venue logistics): enough to plan with suppliers, spot risks early and ask the right questions.
  • Strong organisation: runs several projects in parallel with tight deadlines and clear action lists.
  • Leadership attitude and business mindset: takes ownership, makes decisions and understands commercial impact.
  • Fluent English; [Spanish / Arabic / French / other – to confirm by market].

Nice to have

  • Experience producing multi-market or international events, or in the Middle East, UK or Europe.
  • Background in live entertainment, music, culture or immersive experiences.
  • Existing network of venues and technical suppliers in key markets.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Google Workspace and project-management tools.

You will join a team of highly effective, motivated, and entrepreneurial professionals who move fast, take ownership, and get things done. Cultural fit means being humble, open to feedback, and willing to learn, while approaching challenges as opportunities and making decisions based on data and insight. We value individuals who are hands-on, collaborative, and able to prioritize what truly drives results. We encourage applicants from diverse and unconventional backgrounds, especially those who bring curiosity, a willingness to learn, and the drive to make a meaningful impact.

What you’ll get

  • Attractive compensation package and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance
  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Competitive pension plan
  • Work in the heart of the city, with possible travel across our markets
  • Hybrid working model
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!

Our hiring process 

  • A 30 min video call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers, to better understand your career plan, assess cultural fit and answer any questions you may have
  • A 60 min online test with three topics: logic, analytics and written understanding
  • A 30 min video call with your future manager, to further understand the details of the position/team/company
  • A 45 min business case presentation with your future manager and another senior member of the team (to be prepared in advance)

On average our process lasts 20 working days and offers usually follow within a week.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

jobs.title: Senior Partner Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. 

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? 

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience? 

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About The Role:

  • You will be responsible for the entire life cycle management of big events since the sales and legal team has signed the commercial contract till the events final closing.
  • You will be the main point of contact between all the stakeholders, from the event organizer to all the internal teams involved.
  • Although being overall owner of the whole process you will work as part of a team, you will be in charge of making things happen in time and form by managing other departments tasks.
  • Communicate product needs (Fever usability) and process needs to HQ, work with product/engineering to deliver on them. in order to have a consolidated list of all the requirements and prioritize them with the product team.

About You:

You are degree qualified, with a project management background. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and pride yourself on your flexible, detail-oriented, analytical and organized mindset.

In order to be successful in this role, you will be expected to be an entrepreneurial individual. The role requires a mix of project management and operational experience. You will have to be very comfortable coordinating other departments to ensure the delivery of requirements on time, also delivering results in an ambiguous environment, being exceptionally detail-oriented while looking around corners.

  • 3+ years in a project management role or consulting background. This is not a position for an events background, but having event experience is a plus.

  • Able to handle large amounts of work and parallel work-streams
  • Collaborative and willing to get hands dirty and work on all required events tasks

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Description

🌍 Hello World!

Jesteśmy The Codest - International Tech Software Company z centrami technologicznymi w Polsce dostarczającymi globalne rozwiązania i projekty IT.

Nasze podstawowe wartości leżą w podejściu „Klienci i ludzie na pierwszym miejscu”, które stawia na pierwszym miejscu potrzeby naszych klientów i środowisko współpracy dla naszych pracowników, dzięki czemu dostarczamy naprawdę wyjątkowe produkty i usługi. Nasze doświadczenie koncentruje się na tworzeniu stron internetowych, DevOps oraz QA. Nasza misja stała się jasna po wielu latach tworzenia oprogramowania, obecnie specjalizujemy się w skalowaniu zespołów technologicznych dla klientów i partnerów.

💡Opis projektu:

Nasz klient to jedna z największych platform e-commerce w Europie, z której codziennie korzystają miliony użytkowników. Firma łączy sprzedawców – od małych biznesów po globalne marki – z klientami, oferując ogromny wybór produktów, szybkie dostawy i dopracowane doświadczenie zakupowe. Zespół rozwija skalowalne systemy o bardzo dużym natężeniu ruchu, pracuje w oparciu o dane i eksperymenty, a kultura sprzyja samodzielności, odpowiedzialności i realnemu wpływowi na rozwój produktu oraz sposób robienia zakupów w regionie.

Dołączysz do zespołu, który buduje nową platformę do planowania i uruchamiania kampanii reklamowych w wielu kanałach jednocześnie, używaną przez największe marki na rynku. System musi działać przy bardzo dużej skali ruchu, z naciskiem na wydajność, stabilność i przetwarzanie danych w czasie zbliżonym do rzeczywistego.

Product Manager jest odpowiedzialny za wartość i opłacalność (viability) tego, co buduje zespół produktowy, oraz ostatecznie ponosi odpowiedzialność za wyniki osiągane przez zespół produktowy(obejmuje również obowiązki Product Ownera).

Zakres wiedzy Product Managera:

  • Klient – uznany ekspert w zakresie użytkowników i klientów.
  • Dane – uznany ekspert w zakresie danych produktowych.
  • Biznes – rozumie pełne spektrum ograniczeń i potrzeb biznesowych, w tym strategię wejścia na rynek (go-to-market), aspekty finansowe, prawne oraz zgodność z regulacjami.
  • Branża – ekspert w zakresie konkurencji, trendów rynkowych oraz trendów technologicznych.
  • Produkt – uznany ekspert w zakresie swojego produktu.

Requirements

Szukamy osoby, która ma:

  • Doświadczenie jako Product Manager (lub w podobnej roli) w branży technologicznej.
    Zainteresowanie technologią i swobodę w poruszaniu się w pojęciach takich jak React, Kotlin, Swift czy SDK.
  • Mile widziane doświadczenie w aplikacjach multiplatformowych lub no-code/low-code.
  • Silne umiejętności analityczne, decyzyjność i podejście nastawione na rozwiązywanie problemów.
  • Umiejętność patrzenia na produkt oczami użytkownika i zrozumienia potrzeb klientów.
  • Znajomość Agile oraz praktyczne doświadczenie w zarządzaniu backlogiem produktowym.
  • Doświadczenie we wdrażaniu zmian na podstawie danych, analizy oraz testów A/B.
  • Zdolność tłumaczenia potrzeb biznesowych na rozwiązania technologiczne i odwrotnie.

Na co dzień będziesz zajmować się:

  • Tworzeniem wizji produktu, roadmapy oraz planów rozwoju platformy technologicznej.
  • Współpracą z zespołami w celu zrozumienia potrzeb użytkowników i przekładania ich na nowe funkcjonalności.
  • Priorytetyzacją backlogu oraz dbaniem o to, aby prace zespołu były zgodne z celami strategicznymi.
  • Koordynacją komunikacji pomiędzy różnymi zespołami, aby wszyscy działali w jednym kierunku.

📜 Nasza oferta:

  • 23-25k PLN na B2B.
  • Płatne dni wolne w święta kalendarzowe
  • Dostęp do platformy Worksmile, gdzie co miesiąc przysługuje ci 300zł do wykorzystania na giftcardy lub różnego rodzaju usługi
  • Środowisko pracy doceniające rozwój i innowacje – ty masz pomysły, my chcemy je usłyszeć 😉

📌 Proces rekrutacyjny:

  • 30 minutowa rozmowa z naszą rekruterką, Ewą
  • 1h rozmowa techniczna z naszym CTO, Kubą
  • 1h rozmowy z klientem
  • Oferta

jobs.title: Customer Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Us

Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G-P, we’re dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere.

Our diverse, remote-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated.

The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work.

At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all.

About the position:

As a Customer Project Manager, you will lead end-to-end implementations for G-P’s largest and most complex global customers—organizations expanding across multiple countries and adopting multiple products. You will partner with Sales before the contract is signed to scope the engagement and own the customer relationship until every committed hire is live on payroll, as well as lead major post-launch initiatives like new country launches, bulk onboarding, and M&A expansions.

You are not an HR expert; you are an execution expert who knows what needs to happen, in what order, by when, and who owns it. You serve as the customer’s single point of contact and own the master project plan, partnering closely with regional HR Operations leaders who manage in-country compliance, payroll, and benefits execution.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead pre-sales scoping: Partner with Sales and internal teams to scope multi-product, multi-country deals—setting realistic, country-by-country timelines and pushing back when dates aren’t achievable.
  • Own the master project plan: Build and maintain a single, clear delivery plan covering milestones, dependencies, and owners across both the customer and G-P.
  • Drive cross-functional execution: Coordinate Legal, IT/Integrations, Product, and Support while partnering closely with regional Operations counterparts who lead in-country delivery.
  • Manage integrations early: Identify HRIS, payroll, and finance integration needs upfront and keep technical workstreams on track alongside core onboarding.
  • Keep launches moving: Run clear, standing status updates, manage scope changes, escalate blockers early, and re-engage stalled accounts to protect time-to-value.
  • Deliver through full launch: Sequence country rollouts to get early hires live quickly while long-lead markets progress in parallel, handing off cleanly to Customer Success once the committed headcount is live.
  • Forecast your book: Maintain accurate monthly and quarterly activation forecasts and flag shifts early.

What we’re looking for:

Minimum requirements

  • 6+ years managing complex, customer-facing implementations or professional services projects in B2B SaaS or global services.
  • Proven track record delivering multi-country, multi-product programs with firm deadlines and multiple internal stakeholders.
  • Confidence leading pre-sales scoping conversations with customer HR, Finance, and IT leadership.
  • Hands-on experience scoping and managing system integrations (HRIS, payroll, or finance) within a delivery timeline.
  • Experience partnering closely with an operations counterpart with clear role boundaries.
  • Strong forecasting discipline and crisp, executive-ready written communication.
  • Mandarin speaker & business level english

Preferred requirements:

  • Background in Employer of Record (EOR), global payroll, PEO, immigration, or global mobility.
  • Experience with Workday, NetSuite, or similar enterprise integrations.
  • Fluency in an additional language.

Our ranges are established using objective market benchmarking data for this level of work. Final placement within the range is determined by gender-neutral criteria, including the candidate’s relevant skills, experience, and specific qualifications for the role.

Actual compensation for this position may vary and will depend on multiple factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. For Full-Time Regular Employees, this position is also eligible for additional compensation as follows:

  • Sales Roles: This position is eligible for a commission structure in addition to base salary.
  • Non-Sales Roles: This position is eligible for an annual bonus which is paid dependent on various factors, including and without limitation, individual and company performance in addition to base salary.

Benefits 

G-P values its employees and offers excellent benefits and perks including generous paid parental leave, flexible time off, spending accounts, medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, sabbatical after 5 years and more.

 

Individuals residing, or applying to work, in the United States: California or Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, please review the following additional information:

G-P will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act, Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Act Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Act Ordinance. Los Angeles applicants can review additional information regarding the Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act here: Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and Philadelphia applicants can review information pertaining to Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Record Screening Standards Ordinance here: Fair Chance Poster. Any consideration of a candidate’s background check with arrest or conviction records will include an individualized assessment based on the factors required by applicable law, including the candidate’s specific record and the duties and requirements of the specific job.

G-P. Global Made Possible.

G-P is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, and we are committed to building and maintaining a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity. We prohibit discrimination and harassment against employees or applicants on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

G-P also is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply for these positions. If you need an accommodation due to a disability during the interview process, please contact us at careers@g-p.com.

jobs.title: Transformation Project Manager, Learning & Development - 12 month FTC
jobs.jd_full:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world’s most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We’re committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we’re hiring:

WPP is undertaking one of the most significant transformations of its Learning & Development function as part of our Elevate28 strategy. We are creating a new global Learning & Development operating model designed to simplify how learning is designed, delivered, and experienced across the organisation.

To help bring this vision to life, we’re looking for an experienced Transformation Project Manager to lead the implementation of the new L&D Centre of Excellence (CoE) model. This 12-month fixed-term opportunity will play a critical role in turning strategy into operational reality, ensuring the successful transition to a globally integrated structure that supports capability building at scale across WPP. You will help establish new ways of working, coordinate multiple transformation workstreams, and ensure the organisation is ready to adopt new processes, technologies, and governance structures.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of the L&D transformation programme, ensuring milestones, timelines, resources and deliverables remain on track.
  • Translate the L&D Centre of Excellence blueprint into practical implementation plans, governance structures and operational processes.
  • Drive the transition to the future-state operating model, including organisational design changes, near-shore Design Lab implementation and service migration to Global Business Services (GBS).
  • Coordinate multiple stakeholders, workstreams and delivery partners to ensure successful execution across global, regional and local teams.
  • Establish governance forums, reporting frameworks, dashboards, KPIs and decision-making processes to support programme success.
  • Manage programme risks, dependencies and readiness activities, ensuring impacts are identified early and mitigated effectively.
  • Lead change management, stakeholder engagement and communications activities to drive adoption of new ways of working.
  • Support the implementation and adoption of Workday Learning and other learning technologies, helping learning become more accessible within the flow of work.
  • Build sustainable governance, documentation and operating processes to ensure a seamless handover at the conclusion of the programme.

Who you’ll be working with:

You’ll report to the Chief Learning & Development Officer and work in close partnership with the People Transformation Team. You’ll collaborate with senior leaders across Learning & Development, HR Business Partners, Technology, Data, Finance and Global Business Services (GBS), ensuring alignment across programme workstreams and organisational priorities. You’ll also engage with regional stakeholders, delivery partners and the near-shore Design Lab to ensure the successful implementation of the new operating model.

What you’ll need:

  • Experience delivering project, programme or transformation initiatives within complex, global organisations.
  • Experience leading operating model, organisational design or business transformation programmes, ideally within Learning & Development, HR or broader People functions.
  • Strong programme governance, planning, execution and reporting capabilities with a track record of delivering high-quality outcomes.
  • Proven stakeholder management skills with the ability to build credibility and influence senior leaders across multiple functions.
  • Experience managing service transitions, shared services, GBS, near-shore or offshore delivery models.
  • Strong change management and communication skills, with experience supporting teams through transformation and organisational change.
  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams, competing priorities and complex dependencies in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience using data, reporting and insights to monitor progress, readiness and programme performance.
  • Familiarity with enterprise learning platforms such as Workday Learning, LMS or LXP technologies is highly desirable.
  • Professional certifications such as PRINCE2, PMP, Agile or Prosci are advantageous.
  • Experience working in consulting, professional services, matrixed or global environments would be beneficial.

Who you are:

You’re open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You’re optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You’re extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we’ll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid 

We believe the best work happens when we’re together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That’s why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Blend is a diverse team of problem solvers who believe that the world’s financial resources should be more accessible. Our cloud banking platform is used by Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, and over 330 other financial services firms to acquire more customers, increase productivity, and deliver end-to-end digital experiences. Our software enables our customers to process an average of more than $5 billion in loans per day, making it possible for consumers to reach their financial goals faster and lead better lives. Come do work that matters.

 

Senior Project Manager, Client Activation

Location: Remote (US) · Type: Full-time · Level: IC4 · Reports to: Vice President, Client & Revenue Operations

About the role

Blend’s software powers mortgage, home equity, and consumer banking for many of the largest banks, credit unions, and lenders in the US. Client Activation is the team that takes a signed customer to a live, working product.

You will own the delivery of our most complex customer engagements: Rapid home lending implementations and dedicated engineering PODs that build alongside our largest customers. You run the plan, the dates, the risks, and the governance, working with our Professional Services Consultants, who own the solution, and with Engineering and Product.

It is a senior individual contributor seat. There are no direct reports. We are hiring judgment, structure and follow-through, and someone who already works AI-first.

What you will do

  • Own three to four concurrent customer engagements end to end, from kickoff through go-live, hypercare, and close.
  • Build and maintain the integrated project plan: milestones, dependencies across Blend and the customer, resourcing, and critical path.
  • Run governance: weekly status, SteerCo with customer executives, a live RAID log, and decision records.
  • Run the agile rhythm on dedicated POD engagements: sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, velocity and burn-up reporting, and alignment of sprint output to SOW milestones.
  • Take over projects that are off track: rebuild the plan, set dates the team can hit, clear blockers, and drive escalations to resolution.
  • Manage scope: assess change requests, show their impact on date and effort, and route commercial changes to Deal Desk.
  • Work with Product and Engineering to get go-live blockers prioritized and resolved.
  • Keep TaskRay accurate on every project you own: health, dates, EAC, and weekly status.
  • Use AI as a core part of the job: status drafting, plan analysis and risk spotting, and help us design the next tools for Client Activation.
  • Help set the project management standard for Client Activation: templates, governance, and lessons learned that others use.

What you bring

  • Seven or more years managing customer-facing implementations of enterprise SaaS, with several projects running at once.
  • Experience delivering for banks, credit unions, mortgage lenders, or other regulated financial institutions.
  • Agile delivery experience alongside engineering teams: sprints, velocity, release planning, and backlog governance.
  • A record of recovering projects that were off track, with specifics on what you changed.
  • Executive presence: you run SteerCos, deliver bad news early with options, and hold your ground on scope.
  • Strong command of plans, dependencies, RAID, and change control, in a PSA tool such as TaskRay, Salesforce, Asana, or similar.
  • AI-first working habits. You already use AI tools to do real work faster, can show us how, and know where to check their output.

Nice to have

  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or a similar certification.
  • Mortgage, home equity, or loan origination domain knowledge.
  • Experience with TaskRay on Salesforce.
  • Experience with dedicated development team or co-build engagements governed by a SOW.
  • Hands-on experience building internal automations or AI workflows.

Why you might want this role

  • Ownership of the engagements that matter most to our customers and to Blend, with a direct line to the Vice President, Client & Revenue Operations.
  • Clear, visible impact: projects that go live on time.
  • A new function you help shape, with AI-first tooling already in place.

Compensation

  • Base salary range: $125,000 to $150,000. This applies to full-time hires. Final offer determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to function, level, geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
  • Bonus: Eligibility is contingent upon both company performance against established goals and achievement of individual performance objectives.
  • Equity: Restricted Stock Units in public company stock (NYSE: BLND), so you share in Blend’s long-term growth.

Our Benefits at a Glance

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health and work-life balance.

Health & Wellbeing

  • We offer medical, dental, and vision benefits, with a generous employer contribution that helps keep your medical insurance costs low.
  • Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability coverage
  • Generous PTO, holidays, and maternity/parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): mental health, legal, childcare & eldercare, financial planning, college search, and more
  • Voluntary benefits: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, identity theft, and legal insurance
  • Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, mental health, and well-being
  • Additional perks: Milk Stork, pet insurance, and paid volunteer time off

Growth & Future

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Pre-tax savings: healthcare & dependent care FSAs, Limited Purpose FSA, and HSA
